usage: The word '外公' refers specifically to the grandfather on the mother's side of the family.
'外公' is used as a noun and usually functions as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can address your maternal grandfather directly as '外公' when speaking to him or about him.
In sentences, '外公' often appears before verbs to indicate the person performing an action.
'外公' does not have a plural form; the context usually makes it clear if referring to one or more grandfathers.
